title: The Garden on the Roof
text:
A school in a busy city had no green space, so students asked the principal for a garden. The idea seemed impossible at first because the roof was old and the budget was small. However, parents and local shop owners offered help, and the students raised money by selling plants.

Together they built raised beds from recycled wood and planted vegetables, herbs and flowers. Each class took responsibility for one bed and recorded how fast the plants grew. Within a year, the garden attracted bees and birds, and neighbours began to visit on weekends.

questions.text: What did the students do to raise money?
options: They asked for loans from banks
The number of birds in the city

questions.text: What does the passage suggest about the school before the garden was built?
options: It had few places for students to spend time outdoors
It had a large sports ground
It was located in a quiet village

questions.text: What does the passage suggest about the garden's effect on the community?
options: It brought people together and gained wider support
It caused conflict between parents and teachers
It was closed after one year
It made the school move to another city

paragraph_translations: Uma escola em uma cidade movimentada não tinha espaço verde, então os alunos pediram à diretora um jardim. A ideia parecia impossível no início, porque o telhado era antigo e o orçamento era pequeno. No entanto, pais e donos de lojas locais ofereceram ajuda, e os alunos arrecadaram dinheiro vendendo plantas.

Juntos, construíram canteiros elevados com madeira reciclada e plantaram legumes, ervas e flores. Cada turma ficou responsável por um canteiro e registrou a rapidez com que as plantas cresciam. Em um ano, o jardim atraiu abelhas e pássaros, e os vizinhos começaram a visitá-lo nos fins de semana.
